definitions.explanation: The manager in charge of a section (課) within a department in a company.

examples.japanese: {課長|かちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult with the section chief.

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{課長|かちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Section Chief Tanaka has a business trip next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{課長|かちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}しました→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧。
examples.english: I finally got promoted to section chief.

notes:
{課長|かちょう} is a section manager, an important first management position in Japanese companies.

CORPORATE HIERARCHY:
- ⟦{係長|かかりちょう}→係長：08212_kakarichou⟧: team leader
- {課長|かちょう}: section chief
- ⟦{次長|じちょう}→次長：17780_jichou⟧: deputy department head
- ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: department head

USAGE AS TITLE:
Used after names: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{課長|かちょう} (Section Chief Tanaka). When addressing directly, use {課長|かちょう} alone or with ⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧ in some companies.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {課長|かちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to section chief
- {課長|かちょう}⟦{代理|だいり}→代理：03422_dairi⟧: acting section chief
- {課長|かちょう}⟦{補佐|ほさ}→補佐：19834_hosa⟧: assistant section chief

NOTE:
{課|か} (section) is a subdivision of {部|ぶ} (department).
